issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement's UML declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type int, but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return a StudentCount object and also adds a StudentCount class. This mismatch between the expected primitive int (problem_statement.md) and the solution's StudentCount return type (solution Lecture.java and StudentCount.java) will confuse students and may cause tests or instructions that expect an int to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred: change the solution's getTotalNumberOfStudents() signature to return an int (sum of inscribed and guest students) and update its body and any callers (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents, getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use the int value; remove the StudentCount class if unused. Alternatively, if the StudentCount wrapper is intentional, update the problem statement UML and template to document getTotalNumberOfStudents(): StudentCount and include a short description of StudentCount so students know to implement/return that wrapper type.
